title: Self-Pay Terms: Appointment Fee History and the In-Person Appointments Booking Deposit
content:
**Clause.** For the booking deposit on an In-Person Appointments visit, the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is raised according to the appointment fee charges on the ledger of the patient's Patient Financial Account. The charges counted are no-show fee and late-cancellation fee charges posted with a date of service less than 12 whole months before the payment date.

- Where the ledger shows **2 or more** such charges, the visit type's self-pay booking deposit, for the booking deposit, is doubled (multiplied by 2).
- Where the ledger shows **exactly 1** such charge, it is raised by half (multiplied by 1.5).
- Where the ledger shows **none**, it is taken as it stands (multiplied by 1).

Charges of any other kind are not counted. A no-show fee charge and a late-cancellation fee charge count alike.

**Illustrations (hypothetical ledgers, payment dated 2026-11-02).**

| Appointment fee charges with a date of service inside the 12 whole months | Multiplier | Established Patient Office Visit (75.00) | Specialist Consultation (150.00) |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | 1 | 75.00 | 150.00 |
| one late-cancellation fee | 1.5 | 112.50 | 225.00 |
| one no-show fee and one late-cancellation fee | 2 | 150.00 | 300.00 |
| two late-cancellation fees, one with a date of service of 2025-10-20 | 1.5 (the older one falls outside) | 112.50 | 225.00 |
